content: {"reasoning": "Prior authorization is required and missing, the retroactive-auth window is already closed, and this payer offers no peer-to-peer review. With no valid path to obtain authorization, any submission will be denied CO-197 with no viable appeal (a necessity appeal doesn't cure a procedural auth failure), and the patient cannot be billed for a provider-side auth lapse. Since no action can progress the claim toward collection, the balance is administratively unrecoverable.", "action": "write_off"}
